named_subject: a flat-decked ship seen from above, like an aircraft carrier deck drawn as a long slab
action: The flat deck holds nearly still for the first ten frames, then tilts so its far end swings down to the right and the deck lies on a steeper diagonal through the last six frames.
identity_gap: The animated slab uses the same outline, inner deck line, stepped lower edge and broken right-side verticals as the doodle, so it reads as that drawing.
notes: In the film the carrier turns gradually from frame 9 to 16, but the drawing changes angle in large steps at frames 9, 11 and 13 and the scenery waves jump position at frame 11. Spreading the rotation evenly across frames 8 to 16 would help most.
